# Welcome to WoMD

WoMD is a source-preserving, Git-friendly Markdown editor. This page demonstrates the supported syntax.

## Text formatting

You can write **bold**, *italic*, `inline code`, ~~strikethrough~~, and [links](https://github.com/Data-Bike/womd).

## Lists

Unordered:
- First item
- Second item
  - Nested item

Ordered:
1. Step one
2. Step two

Task:
- [x] Completed task
- [ ] Pending task

## Tables

| Name  | Role   | Active |
| ----- | ------ | ------ |
| Alice | Editor | Yes    |
| Bob   | Review | No     |

## Code

```rust
fn main() {
    println!("Hello, WoMD!");
}
```

## Math

Inline: \( E = mc^2 \)

Display:

\[ x = \frac{-b \pm \sqrt{b^2 - 4ac}}{2a} \]

## Block quote

> Markdown is the source of truth.
